notes.title: The Lost Mines v1.5.1
notes.content: Fixed the bug that affected some players who were unable to unlock the "Seeker" achievement. Now it works correctly, and if you have already discovered the 7 secrets but the achievement wasn't unlocked before the patch, it will unlock on the next game run.

notes.title: The Lost Mines v1.5.0
notes.content:
- Compiled with the latest version of N'gine (1.5.0-stable). This fixes the bug on Windows releases where the rumble effect on controllers had stopped working.
- Raspbian release updated to work with Raspberry PI OS Bookworm (64 bits).
- Completely rewrote the rendering code for the main game to speed up performance on low-end systems.
- Added a new hidden cheat.
- Compiled with the latest Steamworks API (1.58a). (Steam version only).
- Credits scene changed.
